command: Caenorhabditis elegans PGL-1 (Q9TZQ3) has RNA helicase activity, participates in spliceosomal mRNA splicing or nuclear mRNA export. Evaluate each independently. Its exact accession leaf PTN002773363 in current PTHR47958 descends from positive PTN002774595, PTN002776867 and PTN002776405; known helicase-loss nodes PTN002774495 and PTN002773962 are outside its lineage. Reconcile this curated ancestry with the experimentally solved PGL dimerization/RNase fold in PMID:26787882 and the target sequence/domain architecture. Establish whether this is functional divergence, a family/classification problem, or retained activity. Lack of canonical helicase catalysis does not itself exclude noncatalytic splicing or export participation, and perinuclear/cytoplasmic location does not prove exclusive localization. Read target primary studies and source-node context; distinguish untested possibilities from direct negative results.
